messages.subject: Export RefSeq annotated regions
parts:
Hi!

I would like to export the RefSeq annotated DMRs, however, I always get the following error:

> getData(RESULT)
Fehler in (function (classes, fdef, mtable)  : 
  unable to find an inherited method for function ‘getData’ for signature ‘"annotationByGenicParts"’

Is there a step missing or do I need an other command?

Thanks for your help!!

Gerwin

messages.author: e4181d5c40fc094c
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] Export RefSeq annotated regions
parts:
Hi,

This is not possible directly!

A similar question has been answered (for CpG island annotated DMCs) in this forum previously. Altuna has has suggested a possible way to do it. Here is the link to the previous post

By the way, getData() works for methylBase, methylRaw and methylRawList objects only!


Regards,
Kalyan
